findings.description: This bullet still says per-machine values come from `.env` keys, with 'vault paths, personal IDs' as examples. Those examples were the only `.env` consumers (OBSIDIAN_VAULT and the tracker IDs), and this PR deletes them.

process_issues.description: The checkout HEAD was 20a971dfe2be9fcf0fedafe8a72dc3b979e2ddd6, but the PR headRefOid is c2acf9edaf2e57193ac938ed3b92751d5958a2b0, and that commit is not present locally. The `.claude-pr/` copies held the round-1 state. Reviewers and the orchestrator re-checked everything against `gh pr diff 437`, which is authoritative. The only finding is on a line both commits leave unchanged.

Skipped correctness, security, context, simplicity, guards, workflow-safety and spec. The change is docs only: skill deletions and README/skill prose edits, with no logic, no trust boundary, no workflow and no new constructs.
